problem: What are the dimensions of the matrix $Y$, where $Y=[\begin{aligned}-\sqrt{7} & 10 & -2 \\ -4 & 0 & -5 \\ 1 & \sqrt{2} & -\sqrt{3}\end{aligned}]?$

examples.knowledge_point: Determining the Dimensions of a Matrix
examples.problem:
What are the dimensions of the matrix ${A},$ where 

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & 5 & 1 \\ -2 & 0 & 6 \\ 3 & 2 & -5 \\ 5 & 1 & 7\end{aligned}]
$$
examples.worked_solution: The matrix ${A}$ has $4$ rows and $3$ columns. Therefore, its dimensions are $4\times 3.$
